projection: Learned bias-free 128 to 24 followed by a shared 32-wide classifier. 32-dimensional vectors are zero-extended with inactive columns. Qwen32 centered uses only the mean of public ontology rows, followed by L2 normalization. Qwen128 and random128 have matched active projection width. Ordinary/domain embedding tables are trainable and matched to each other.
window: Same last 256 slots for all neural arms. Disjoint means for last slot, preceding 15, preceding 48, and preceding 192 slots. No time intervals. This head resolves recency bands but not within-band order.
optimization: CPU two threads; AdamW lr 0.002 weight decay 0.01, BCE positive weight 20, early stop by development AP. All neural arms use the same seeds and epoch cap.
domain_pretrain: Directional adjacent-event positive log lift followed by truncated SVD32. Deterministic 1 in 10 internal training rows reserved once for next-event diagnostic vs training target popularity; refit on full training pool for transfer. No fraud labels or development events enter the fit.
lexical_reference: V3 frozen seed42 LR settings, full vs suffix 256, with and without the published numeric panel. Fit only on frozen train, no grid search.
scope: Gate 2 and Gate 4 are distinct prespecified comparisons. Gate 4 evaluates the Qwen128 and random128 arms regardless of Gate 2 ranking. Published numeric fields are retrospective covariates. No test membership or labels loaded.
continuation: Semantic progression requires all three matched same-seed AP deltas positive and a strictly positive paired sequence-cluster 95% interval against matched random and ordinary within the same input panel. Mixed evidence stops complex fusion and LoRA.
